### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately report patient-stated symptoms; do not negate or alter explicitly mentioned complaints.
[O-Section]: Report objective measurements (e.g., temperature) exactly as stated in the transcript, including units. Do not convert units unless explicitly instructed.
[A-Section]: Base assessment statements strictly on the doctor's explicit interpretations and diagnostic reasoning. Do not infer severity or immediate action beyond what is stated.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately report patient-stated symptoms; do not negate or alter explicitly mentioned complaints.
[O-Section]: Report objective measurements (e.g., temperature) exactly as stated in the transcript, including units. Strictly adhere to the units provided in the transcript; do not perform any unit conversions (e.g., Fahrenheit to Celsius) unless explicitly instructed.
[A-Section]: Base assessment statements strictly on the doctor's explicit interpretations and diagnostic reasoning. Do not infer the severity or character of patient-reported symptoms from objective findings unless explicitly linked by the doctor. Strictly limit diagnostic possibilities and etiologies to those explicitly stated by the doctor; do not infer them from planned investigations or contingent actions.
